data.ruling: The refutation stands. The re-rank dropped TPS3850H33DRCT (Texas Instruments) only because P3 gave no figures and the re-rank did not read the data sheet. That is a gap in the re-rank's reading. It names no requirement value the part fails. I re-read the data sheet, TI's product page and JLCPCB. The part meets every reset-supervisor value and passes rules 2 and 4 and the lifecycle gate. The drop does not hold. The scope is function: the drop was a qualification call against this function's requirements, not a finding about the part itself. Two board-level conditions follow from the data sheet, and neither fails a value. (1) The watchdog has to be disabled: SET0 = 1 and SET1 = 0, with WDI tied to VDD or GND, because WDI cannot float when the watchdog is disabled. (2) SENSE goes to the 3.3 V rail, and RESET, an open-drain output, takes a pull-up of 1 kOhm to 100 kOhm.
data.evidence:
Data sheet SBVS301B (October 2016, revised September 2021):
- Table 11-1: H = VIT+(OV) +7 % and VIT-(UV) -7 %; 33 = 3.3 V nominal.
- Section 6.5: accuracy of VIT-(UV) and VIT+(OV) is nominal +/-0.8 %, over TJ -40 to 125 degC.
- UV threshold: 3.069 V nominal, 3.0445 V to 3.0936 V.
- VHYST 0.2 % to 0.8 %, so the release point is at most 3.118 V. That is below 3.201 V (3.3 V - 3 %).
- Band from the lowest threshold to 3.201 V: 156.5 mV.
- OV threshold: at least 3.503 V (3.531 V nominal - 0.8 %). That is above 3.399 V (3.3 V + 3 %).
- VPOR is at most 0.8 V. VUVLO is 1.35 V typical, and RESET is driven low below it. Above VPOR, RESET stays low until SENSE is inside the window and tRST has run.
- The threshold is above the minimum supplies of the selected parts: 74HC423 at 2.0 V (Nexperia 74HC423 data sheet, read 2026-09-29T05:39:27Z) and 74AUP1G32 at 0.8 V (Nexperia 74AUP1G32 data sheet, read 2026-09-29T05:39:29Z).
- Section 6.6: tRST is 170 ms to 230 ms with CRST open, or 8.5 ms to 11.5 ms with 10 kOhm to VDD. Both are well above the 125 ns minimum found for V43 (the 74HC423 nRD pulse width). Startup delay is 300 us.
- Section 6.3: VDD 1.6 V to 6.5 V, so it runs on the 3.3 V rail. TJ -40 to 125 degC covers the 0 to 50 degC of V38.
- Section 6.6: CWD open with SET0 = 1 and SET1 = 0 disables the watchdog. WDO is a separate output.

Maker: Texas Instruments is on S1.
